svg.title: Claude Pelican 1
svg.desc: One white pelican rides a small road bike around a round world, and every chapter changes the medium: a pencil line on ivory, a chalk cyanotype bridge, the burning limb of the sun, a black-figure frieze on a Greek vase, three friends screen-printed on kraft paper, a lace doily on black velvet, and a watercolour hill in the rain. It closes on the name Claude Pelican 1: one pelican, every style.

g.text: Every morning, the pelican goes for a ride.
Some days, the world is still being drawn.
